variants.when: Jaguar models with a sensor in each wheel (for example the 2011 XF)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, using an accurate gauge.
There is no reset button. The warning clears once the tires are at the correct pressure and the system reads them again.
Drive above about 18 mph for at least 10 minutes so every wheel is checked.
If a sensor or wheel was replaced, drive for at least 15 minutes, then leave the car parked for 15 minutes so the new sensor is learned.
If the warning stays on after that, have the tires and system checked by a qualified shop.
variants.note: If the light flashes first and then stays on, or a tire pressure monitoring system fault message shows, the system has a fault that setting pressures will not clear.

notes: Jaguar tire pressure systems use wheel sensors and relearn by driving, with no driver reset button. The handbook we opened shows a SERVICE REQUIRED message when the service distance is reached but gives no driver reset, so ask the shop that did the service to reset it.
